a: Most single schools are up and running in 5–7 working days. Our team moves your student, teacher and past records over from Excel for you, sets up your classes and timetable, and trains your staff in live sessions. School groups usually start one branch at a time, over 3–4 weeks.

q: Is our data safe and compliant?
a: Yes. Your data is stored securely and locked so outsiders can't read it, and sensitive records get extra protection. Each school's data is kept completely separate, people see only what their role allows, every change is recorded, and you can sign anyone out instantly. Family documents are kept in a locked store for 7 years.

q: Can we use our own branding and domain?
a: Yes. Add your school's logo and colours, use your own web address, send emails in your school's name, and personalise the login page, app opening screen and even notification sounds. Showing "Powered by Sarasvi" is your choice.

q: Does it work on basic smartphones and slow internet?
a: Yes. The Android and iPhone apps keep working without internet: attendance, homework and marks entered offline are saved and sent automatically once you're back online. The website can be added to your phone's home screen, and you can make text bigger, reduce movement or switch to high contrast.

q: How do the AI features handle student privacy?
a: AI features are switched on only if your school chooses. Predictions use only your own school's data, and the Study Buddy and question helpers never use your data to train outside systems. Counsellors decide who sees wellbeing alerts, and every AI action is recorded.

q: What about fees — can parents pay inside the app?
a: Yes. Set fee plans, send invoices, give concessions and send due-date reminders. Parents pay inside the app by UPI, card, net banking or wallet, and your accounts update instantly. Staff salaries (basic, HRA, DA, deductions) are handled too, and reports export to Excel for your auditor.
